decision.summary: NO_ACTION: the live 76k DIP position is now discarded for slot purposes, but there is still no clean replacement trade or valid take-profit action.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. Reconciliation is clean, daily_success_cooldown is inactive, and the existing will-bitcoin-dip-to-76k-on-may-26 Yes position remains open, but it is now discarded for slot purposes because current probability is about 0.185, below the 0.20 threshold. That does not justify any exit: avg_price is 0.5299, so the <65% take-profit rule would still require an executable full-position sell price of at least 0.75, while the live book is only around 0.17 bid / 0.20 ask, and no stop-loss or discretionary invalidation sale is allowed. A fresh entry was reconsidered because the discarded position no longer blocks the slot, but the current board still offers no materially cleaner setup. Binance has cooled to neutral, 12h price action is modestly higher, 48h is net higher, and bearish_bias_correction is active again, so another bearish DIP would require explicit rejection evidence that is still missing. The nearest upside alternative, 78k REACH Yes around 0.44, is not a clean daily momentum trade either because Binance is not showing very clear same-day continuation and BTC remains in a flatter range regime. With the discarded bearish position still counting as real account pain, no valid exit, and no cleaner replacement on either side, the correct decision is NO_ACTION.
